purpose: Evaluate the same public OECD non-consolidated Romania stock/transaction boundary against the independently documented ECB QFA horizontal-consistency criterion, per financial instrument, using exact decimal arithmetic. The gate cannot alter bilateral Accounting Spine readiness.

horizontal_identity.algebraic_equivalent_source_identity: S1M + S11 + S12 + S13 + S2 net for each instrument; S121 cancels between F and BNR.

official_threshold_gate.threshold_basis: ECB QFA national-data internal-consistency quality reports; horizontal consistency is per financial instrument.

fx_safety_check.requirement: All returned RON-per-EUR rates covering the test period must be > 1.
fx_safety_check.interpretation: Then abs(residual) < 10 million RON is strictly stronger than abs(residual) < EUR 10 million, so no choice between average and end-of-period conversion is needed.

official_threshold_gate.pass_rule: Every stock and flow residual for every quarter and each F2-F8 instrument must satisfy abs(exact_decimal_residual_million_ron) < 10.0, and the ECB FX safety check must pass.
official_threshold_gate.indeterminate_rule: If any residual is >= 10.0 million RON but source/row/value gates otherwise pass, stop as INDETERMINATE_EXACT_EUR_CONVERSION_RULE_REQUIRED; do not choose a conversion convention after observing which measure failed.
official_threshold_gate.fail_rule: Row/semantic conflict, missing/duplicate/non-finite value, or an official FX safety check failure causes FAIL/INDETERMINATE as specified; the gate may not be rescued by aggregate cancellation across instruments.

promotion_rule: A complete PASS authorizes only a separate explicit reference-mode promotion assessment. It does not itself promote sectoral_financial_positions and cannot change Accounting Spine instrument completeness.

execution_policy.activation_condition: pull_request on exact branch AND github.run_attempt > 1
